FoodDescription:
Roasted whole chicken (herb‑seasoned, e.g., thyme) served with roasted sides: roasted potato wedges, roasted sliced mushrooms, roasted broccoli, diced roasted sweet potato/carrot, and green peas.

**Variety / preparation:** A roast‑chicken dinner — oven‑roasted/baked chicken with roasted root vegetables and vegetables, finished with fresh herbs.
